stages.seo-autopilot: Crawled 114 sitemap URLs and 122 internal link targets before and after release. No technical findings or duplicate primary keyword targets. The planner serves calculator intent and the startup budget article serves guide intent. The two comparison queries did not establish enough distinct intent to justify a page.
stages.blog-refresher: Skipped because finalized Search Console page-and-query data was unavailable, so positions 8–20 and meaningful impressions could not be verified.
stages.seo-title-optimization: Published an editorial title, H1, metadata and copy correction on the AI Budget Planner. Current search results supported monthly cost forecasting as the query intent. Source code and production copy established the mismatch.

evidence.search_console: Unchecked. GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON was unavailable to the local job, so clicks, impressions, CTR, position and URL Inspection could not be measured.
evidence.analytics: Unchecked. The local job did not have SEO_GA4_PROPERTY_ID or the Google service account.
evidence.serp: Built-in web search used for editorial intent and comparison research. Exact Google rankings were unchecked because SERPAPI_API_KEY was unavailable.
evidence.semrush: The connected account had insufficient API units.

ai_visibility.queries: The five stable prompts in seo/queries.json.
ai_visibility.ChatGPT Search: Unchecked. No direct measurement integration configured.
